selection_policy: Choose the smallest unblocked testable improvement in the current bottleneck; no task just to fill cadence.

tasks.trigger: First authorized engineering pilot or observed inability to reproduce the approved/candidate/missing frontier from fixture data.
tasks.goal: Create a deterministic, fixture-safe frontier summary and review-queue contract over the existing transaction-evidence artifact. Do not run the historical live campaign.
allowed_changes: Small source adapter or pure function
Targeted tests and short runbook section
acceptance: One transaction with two candidate links counts once in candidate-only transaction coverage; relation counts stay distinct.
Approved proof and candidate-only and missing are exclusive transaction states, with a pinned denominator.
A bill or statement does not count as an approved proof of payment.
No real data is accessed, no original documents are moved, and no coverage counts or identities appear in Git diffs.
Existing evidence artifact schema remains unchanged or separately escalated before any incompatible change.
python -m pytest passes using only synthetic fixtures.
tasks.owner_gate: Approve first Codex code-only pilot and isolated runner; do not dispatch solely from READY_FOR_REVIEW.
tasks.outcome: A reviewable PR and a deterministic no-private-data frontier report function.

tasks.trigger: EV-001 accepted and a human reviewer reports candidate ambiguity or repeat handling.
tasks.goal: Add idempotent candidate review decisions, explicit rejection reasons and no silent promotion to approved.
allowed_changes: Local reviewer-facing export using synthetic identifiers
acceptance: Each approved/rejected decision resolves exactly one previously observed candidate key and is replayable.
Conflicting decisions, stale candidate IDs and duplicate review rows fail closed.
Prior human rejections are not resurrected by new matching runs.
No document or ledger data is rewritten and no autonomous approval is introduced.
tasks.owner_gate: Approve any semantics or contract changes before coding.
tasks.outcome: Reviewer decisions persist in a reproducible approval layer without changing ledger truth.

tasks.trigger: The existing PM/MI cohort is verified and the owner approves one additional payer class/scope.
tasks.goal: Parameterize the payer filter behind an explicit allowlist and support separately named payer populations without silently changing the old denominator.
acceptance: Old PM/MI fixture output is byte/semantic equivalent when the new option is not selected.
New cohort is opt-in and its population hash, count, payer aliases and periods are recorded.
Payer identity, who transferred, and legal obligor are separate fields where source supports them.
Cross-payer mirrored payments and shared proofs do not inflate document or transaction counts.
Unrecognized payer/alias or mixed scope fails closed; no inference of legal liability or occupancy.
tasks.owner_gate: Explicit approval of the new payer scope and denominator is mandatory; no real-file execution by Codex.
tasks.outcome: One safe extension mechanism, not hard-coded payer-by-payer pipelines.

tasks.trigger: A reviewed false-positive or new bill source shows the need for differentiated document-kind handling.
tasks.goal: Strengthen payment proof vs invoice/liability vs statement context classification and relation checks.
allowed_changes: Document-kind inference guarded by explicit evidence features
acceptance: An unpaid tax bill cannot become payment_proof by matching amount/date alone.
A bank/card statement remains contextual unless direct proof criteria are validated.
A shared payment receipt can support multiple legitimate ledger legs without creating new facts.
Unknown document types remain candidates/review-needed rather than guessed approvals.
tasks.owner_gate: Change of semantic interpretation requires explicit reviewer sign-off.
tasks.outcome: Fewer false positives and better bill-to-payment traceability.

tasks.trigger: An explicit source-root and read-only inspection packet is approved and candidate-review capacity is available.
tasks.goal: Design a bounded, allowlisted document search frontier with content-hash dedupe, source-cursor resume and no-result reporting.
allowed_changes: Tests for path containment and no-result runs
acceptance: No recursive global search or unexpected symlink escape; one approved root and budget per run.
Source bytes are never sent to a remote model by default.
Repeated search yields no duplicate evidence IDs or candidate keys.
Every investigated missing transaction records searched scope, timestamp, result and next step without leaking private IDs to public logs.
No APPLY/move/backups/delete and no real-source run in this PR.
tasks.owner_gate: Approve the exact private root/source and permitted search actions in a separate execution packet.
tasks.outcome: An auditable source-search boundary, not a general crawler.

tasks.trigger: One reviewed new evidence snapshot exists for an approved canonical run.
tasks.goal: Check exact-run snapshot/reporter compatibility and per-population cutoff/coverage semantics before making any public/private report.
acceptance: Snapshot source ledger SHA and required transaction population must match the selected canonical run.
Historical evidence cutoff is visible and not inherited from a newer unrelated accounting report.
Only operator-approved payment/transfer proofs are attached and allowlisted by hash.
No public bundle, latest pointer, live ingestion, or Viewer deployment is modified.
tasks.owner_gate: Accounting owner approval for any cross-repo data contract change.
tasks.outcome: Validated report pipeline; publication remains a separate action.

tasks.trigger: A real test failure, stale flow reference, dependency drift, or malformed artifact is detected.
tasks.goal: Perform bounded hygiene: rerun fixture tests, fix one reproducible bug, reconcile legacy flow references; avoid speculative refactors.
allowed_changes: One updated reference and deprecation note
acceptance: Before/after failure is reproduced on synthetic fixtures.
No old PromptFlow runtime is revived and no new orchestration framework is introduced.
No broad lint/format rewrites or dependency modernization without a failing contract.
Status reports NO_OP if there is nothing broken or stale.
tasks.outcome: Less rework and maintenance debt, not growing a second workflow.

tasks.trigger: Accounting owner has approved a current evidence report bundle and a documented delivery/privacy policy.
tasks.goal: Ensure the read-only Viewer discovers the evidence report in its Rendición chapter without changing report content or exposing private attachments prematurely.
acceptance: Report appears only when its approved catalog contains it.
All proof links and attachment hashes pass acceptance, without copying CSV/ledgers.
Mixed run/cutoff differences are visible and no old evidence snapshot masquerades as current.
No deployment or report-data mutation occurs inside the coding PR.
tasks.owner_gate: Publication and attachment exposure require explicit separate approval.
tasks.outcome: A discoverable report without a second evidence engine.
